title: Billable Split
user: A contractor buying materials for several jobs at once who must split one supplier receipt into billable, non-billable, and reimbursable job costs without losing the source record.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA that stores a receipt image, creates manual line items, allocates each line across jobs with billable flags, and exports per-job CSV/PDF evidence.
constraints: Receipt images can contain payment and tax information; encrypt local backups and allow permanent deletion; allocation export must retain immutable source-image hashes.
